theater_main_quest_01_01_01_002:
...descended to the mortal world where you
"children" live, looking for excitement.
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_003: And then we made up our minds.
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_004:
We'd live here in the mortal world
with all of you, forever.
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_005:
We'd seal away our divine power and have
fun living with all the hassle and hardship.
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_006: There's only one thing we can give you.
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_007:
The power to fight monsters—
a blessing we call Falna.
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_008:
Children who receive it become
that god's followers...
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_011:
...and the one and only member
of the Hestia Familia.
theater_main_quest_01_01_01_012:
Are you even listening, Bell?
Bell?
theater_main_quest_01_01_02_103:
This high up in the Dungeon...?
But why...?!
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_001:
What were you thinking, diving all the way
down to the 5th floor out of nowhere?!
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_002:
Going into the Dungeon solo, without a party,
is dangerous enough as it is!
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_003:
What do I always tell you?
Adventurers shouldn't go on adventures!
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_005:
...Bell, you got really, really lucky.
You know that, right?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_006:
You're a Level 1 who's been diving for
barely two weeks. A Minotaur attacked you,
and you came home alive!
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_008:
Anyway, I'm just glad you're okay.
Be more careful from now on, all right?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_009:
And let's not go sprinting through town
covered in blood anymore, okay?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_011:
...So, um...
about that info on Ms. Ais...
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_012:
Hmm? What's this?
Don't tell me, Bell...
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_013: Ms. Wallenstein, the one who saved you...
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_014: You've gone and fallen for her, haven't you?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_017:
Loki Familia, currently Level 5. She's one
of the two finest swords in all of Orario,
and the title the gods gave her is...
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_018: A princess of the sword: "Sword Princess."
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_019:
Even I know that much! I mean stuff like
her hobbies...her favorite food...and, um...
well...
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_022: Hmm... I've never heard anything like that.
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_024: But realistically, I think it'd be tough.
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_026:
You received the goddess Hestia's Falna.
You're part of the Hestia Familia now, right?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_027:
Ms. Wallenstein is one of the Loki Familia's
executives. Getting close to her would
cause all kinds of problems. You get that?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_029:
Come on, chin up.
Go cash in the magic stones you got today.
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_034:
You know... women really are drawn to men
who are strong and dependable, so...
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_035:
If you don't give up and keep working hard,
maybe Ms. Wallenstein will notice you too—
once you've gotten stronger.
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_036:
Right!
Thank you so much, Miss Eina!
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_038: Was I...a little too nice to him?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_042: Wha—?! Oh, for crying out loud!
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_044:
What's with that guy?
Is he okay?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_045:
Some greenhorn probably bit off more
than he could chew, huh?
theater_main_quest_01_01_03_051:
Please tell me about
Ms. Ais Wallensteeeeein!!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_003:
Welcome home, Bell!
You're back early today, huh?
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_004:
Yeah.
I kinda almost died in the Dungeon...
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_005:
Huh? Are you okay?! Does it hurt?
If you went and died on me, I'd be crushed!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_006:
I'm fine, Goddess, really.
I'm the only member of the Hestia Familia!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_007:
I'm not about to leave you
out on the street.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_008:
Ooh, you said it now!
Then I'm counting on you to take care
of me, so you'd better be ready!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_009:
Oh, right!
I brought home a tasty treat for you today.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_011: Where'd you get all those potato puffs?
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_012:
I started part-time at their stand, remember?
Business picked up, so they gave me these
as a thank-you!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_013: Let's make dinner tonight a real party...
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_014:
Bell...
I'm not letting you sleep tonight, y'know?
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_017: ...My Agility went up quite a bit, huh?
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_018:
Yep. Probably from getting chased
by that Minotaur.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_019:
Magic's still at 0, though...
Think I'll ever be able to use magic?
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_020: Hmm, even I can't tell you that.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_021:
...Oh, Goddess.
What about this Skill slot...?
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_022:
Hm...? Oh, my hand slipped a little.
It's blank, same as always.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_024:
*Sigh*... I wish there were some way
to get stronger, and fast.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_025:
(Mortal children can change so easily...
They're nothing like us unchanging gods.)
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_027:
(Rapid growth. Lasts as long as the longing
endures, and grows stronger with the depth
of that longing...)
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_028:
Congrats, Bell.
You've finally got a Skill of your own.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_029:
But it stings!
Someone else is the one who changed you!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_044:
Still, nobody wants to join
this Familia, huh~?
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_045:
Guess that's what I get
for being a no-name goddess.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_046:
The Falna's the same no matter
which god is looking after you, though.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_047:
...Well, I wouldn't mind it being just
the two of us a little longer, but—
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_049:
Urk...! N-no no no no!
I really do feel bad about putting
the whole burden on you, Bell!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_050:
Don't worry about it.
You're working hard too, Goddess.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_052: You even got us dinner tonight.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_053: But this is all I can do...
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_054:
If only I could use Arcanum—my divine power.
But there's a rule against using it
in the mortal world...
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_055:
I'm sorry you got stuck in a contract
with a hopeless goddess like me.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_059:
Our Familia's only just getting started!
If we push through this, I know things'll
get easier... Right?!
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_062:
Thank you!
I'm so lucky I met a kid like you.
theater_main_quest_01_01_04_063:
All right, let's update your Status
for the sake of our future!
theater_main_quest_01_01_05_010:
Oh, s-sorry.
Can I help you?
theater_main_quest_01_01_05_012:
A magic stone?
I thought I cashed them all in yesterday...
theater_main_quest_01_01_05_014:
You're an adventurer, aren't you?
Heading to the Dungeon this early?
theater_main_quest_01_01_05_019:
Oh, no, I couldn't!
Not a lunch from someone I just met.
theater_main_quest_01_01_05_021:
Don't worry about it.
I get a staff meal once the shop opens.
theater_main_quest_01_01_05_023:
In exchange,
please have dinner at our place tonight.
theater_main_quest_01_01_05_029:
That was close...
Was the goddess half-asleep or something...?
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_004:
I haven't introduced myself yet.
I'm Syr Flover.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_005:
So you're Syr's friend, huh?
Pretty cute face for an adventurer!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_007:
That ain't gonna fill you up.
Here, today's special.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_008: Young fella like you shouldn't hold back.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_013:
Hee-hee, sorry about that.
Looks like tonight's wages will be good, too.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_015:
All kinds of people come here.
It's fun, don't you think?
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_016:
With so many people, there's always
something new to discover... I can't help
my eyes lighting up.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_017:
You could say meeting new people is my
hobby... It just makes my heart flutter.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_019:
Nya!
Our guests with a reservation are here, meow!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_027:
Y'all did great on the Dungeon expedition!
Tonight, we party!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_028:
The Loki Familia are regulars here.
Their patron goddess, Lady Loki, has taken
quite a liking to the place.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_030:
Aw yeah.
Ais! Let's tell everybody that story already!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_032:
Y'know, the Minotaurs that got away on the
way back! You finished off the last one
on the 5th floor, right?!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_033:
And, y'know, that
tomato boy who was there!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_034:
Some scrawny little newbie brat playing
adventurer! Got cornered by that runaway
Minotaur!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_035:
He got soaked in that stinkin' cow's blood
when you diced it up... Ended up lookin'
like a big ol' ripe tomato!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_037:
And get this!
Tomato boy goes screamin' off somewhere!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_038:
Our princess saves the kid, and he bolts!
Ha-ha-ha! How pathetic can you get?!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_039:
...I think that was understandable,
given the situation.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_042:
Letting those Minotaurs escape on the 17th
floor was our blunder in the first place.
Have some shame.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_043:
Huh?
What's wrong with calling trash trash?
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_047:
Say it was between me and that tomato boy.
Who'd you pick? Huh?!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_050:
If that kid came on to you, would you
take him? Hell no, right?!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_051:
Some spineless small fry weaker than you
ain't got any right to stand by your side!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_052: And you of all people would never allow it!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_053:
Small fry like him ain't in the same
league as Ais Wallenstein!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_058:
Skippin' out in Mama Mia's place?
Gutsy little guy.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_064: Drink up, as much as ya want!!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_065:
This one's 300 valis,
and a drink is 200 valis.
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_066:
I've got 4,400 valis thanks to the
drop items, but...
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_067: No, really, I didn't order that!
theater_main_quest_01_01_06_070:
I want to put some money aside
for the Familia's sake, too...
theater_main_quest_01_01_07_001:
Bell, where on earth did you go...?
You've been out all night...
theater_main_quest_01_01_08_001:
Listen up, Bell.
Tonight you take the bed, not the sofa.
theater_main_quest_01_01_08_002: You're hurt, so don't you dare argue, okay?
theater_main_quest_01_01_08_004:
Heh-heh... But in return,
maybe I'll just crawl in with you~
theater_main_quest_01_01_08_009:
W-wait, Bell! This is where you usually
panic! I only said it to see how you'd
react, so, um, basically, what I mean is—!
